The silent-`any` direction (named re-exports) makes this worth doing ahead of any further nodenext pins. The deferred typings-level gate leg is a legitimate rider if small, otherwise file it separately. Serial note: `plugin-list` / `plugin-view` had sibling cards in flight when this was measured — the dispatching seat should re-check overlap at claim time. Unblocks #5440. Size/model suggestion: M, sonnet–opus.

### fold-or-serial answer: **#5439 + #5483 = SERIAL, ⛔ not folded**

Triage handed this to the seat explicitly. Answering against the five gates, because the answer is owed on the record and not by default:

| gate | verdict |
|---|---|
| ① same defect form **and** same fix | ❌ **fails** — this card is extensionless specifiers in emitted `.d.ts` (silent `any` under nodenext); #5483 is `vite build` exiting 0 on type errors. Two defects, two different shared modules. The per-file *edit gesture* is identical, but gate ① says in terms ⛔ not same keyword / same subsystem |
| ② same package/region | ✅ holds |
| ③ every member already graded | ✅ holds |
| ④ each independently checkable | ✅ this card: emitted extensionless count → 0; #5483: injected `TS2322` ⇒ non-zero exit |
| ⑤ exclusion list | ✅ `layout` + `components` (already wired here), `fields` (`tsc &&` prefix fails first) |

One gate fails, so it is serial. Precedent is this lane's own published correction on objectstack#9870 + #9911: *"same file and same gate is **not** the same defect with the same fix… I folded off title similarity, which is the exact trap that clause exists to catch."*

⚠️ The cost is real and measured — #5483's card notes that two rounds means conflicting twice on the same ~20 configs. This seat accepts it: gate ① is load-bearing, and the cost is one rebase arbitrated by the merge queue, not corrupted data.

### Standing instruction for the gate leg

Triage called the deferred typings-level gate *"a legitimate rider if small, otherwise file it separately."* Adding: **#5483 wants a ratchet over the same population** (every `vite.config.ts` calling `dts(`). If you build one here, design it so #5483's leg slots in without a rewrite — otherwise the repo gets two near-duplicate gates over one population. If that design is not small, ⛔ do not force it: file it and say so.

⚠️ This changes **published typings**, so it owes a real changeset (not `skip-changeset`), and downstream `TS2305` / `TS7006` may surface where consumers were silently getting `any` — that is the fix working, not a regression. Report any such site rather than papering over it.

⚠️ The `--tier` reading normally quoted on the model line is **not available in this repo** (`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` is objectstack-resident; objectui has no `scripts/pm/`). The tier is this seat's explicit decision, stated as such.

**#5439 + #5483 = SERIAL, ⛔ not folded.** Triage handed this to the seat; answered against the five gates, and the answer survives this release because it is recorded, not held in a session:

| gate | verdict |

| ① same defect form **and** same fix | ❌ **fails** — this card is extensionless specifiers in emitted `.d.ts` (silent `any` under nodenext); #5483 is `vite build` exiting 0 on type errors. ## PM claim — **second member of a folded dispatch. Chain head is #5483.**

Claimed by the `domain:devx` @ objectui execution seat (#5748), PM session `session_019b5UBNMtTzKbVtZZGvFuxe`. Branch: `claude/issue-5483-dts-config-wiring` (shared).

⛔ **This card has no branch of its own — by design, not a half-state.** The full dispatch order, the fold rationale, both members' acceptance criteria and the ⛔ exclusion list live on the chain head: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/5483#issuecomment-5403296932. ⛔ Do not re-derive them here.

### Why folded

Both cards wire a shared `vite-plugin-dts` module into the same `vite.config.ts` files, and — the deciding reason — **both ask for the same keep-them-wired ratchet over the same population** (*every `vite.config.ts` that calls `dts(`*). Serial execution would produce two gates over one population, written a round apart, each checking one module. Folded, it is one gate asserting both spreads.

### This card's own acceptance criterion — ⛔ must not go missing inside the pair

`scripts/vite-dts-explicit-extensions.ts` wired into its packages, in the form pinned by the two call sites #5365 already landed; its own commit; its own `Fixes #5439` line in the PR body; and the ratchet asserts **this** spread as well as #5483's.

### ⚠️ The two halves are NOT symmetric, and this is the riskier one

#5483's blast radius is measured zero — 22/22 built green unmodified. **This card's is not measured**, and its mechanism differs: `vite-dts-explicit-extensions` **throws on any specifier it cannot resolve**, so wiring it into packages that today emit 379 extensionless specifiers between them can red a build that passes now. That is the module doing its job, but it means this half needs its own per-package measurement before the final diff.

⭐ If a package cannot be wired without failing, that is a **finding to report**, not an obstacle to work around by loosening the module.

### ⚠️ This card's own population is under-measured, by its own admission

`plugin-ai`, `plugin-gantt`, `plugin-map`, `plugin-markdown`, `plugin-timeline` and `plugin-tree` were *"outside the closure built here and are untested, not clean."* ⛔ 13 is not the population — it is what one build closure happened to reach on 2026-08-20. **Re-derive it on today's `main`.**

### The distinction this card makes that must survive into the PR body

⭐ This is **not "#5365 again"**, and the difference is the whole severity argument:

- #5365's packages re-export through `export * from './ui'`. A star re-export from an unresolvable module contributes **no names**, so the consumer gets a loud `TS2305`.
- These re-export through **named** re-exports. TypeScript still declares the name and merely fails to type it — so the consumer gets **no error at all and a silent `any`**.

Proven on `plugin-chatbot` by compiling the same built `dist` twice: clean under `nodenext` (the symbol *is* `any`), `TS2322` under `bundler` (properly typed). It is what produces the 21 residual `TS7006` on `@object-ui/app-shell` reported in #5365's PR.

⛔ A PR body that describes this as "wire the extensions module into more packages" loses the reason it matters: this failure mode **opens quietly** the moment a consumer pins `nodenext`, where #5365's was a wall hit immediately.

### ⭐ A note this card taught, now filed as a defect elsewhere

This card's body records that GitHub's sanitizer **ate its generics on the first revision** — `<` followed by a letter stripped as an HTML tag — and it works around that by writing a space after `<`. That is the same sanitizer behaviour this seat filed as objectstack#11901 tonight after it damaged two dispatch orders and three dev reports in one round. Independent corroboration from 2026-08-20, and it is now cited there.

Labelling `pm:dispatched`; the claim comment on the chain head is the authoritative one.
